source: CT Law Article 30 · Ministerial Decision No. 126 of 2023 · FTA Guide CTGIDL1
headline: BORROWING HEAVILY?
YOUR INTEREST

items: **Net interest up to AED 12 million** a year: no cap applies
**Above that:** deduct the higher of **AED 12 million** or **30% of adjusted EBITDA**
**Disallowed interest** carries forward for **10 tax periods**
Interest on debt agreed **before 9 December 2022** is outside the rule
